title: Inject a cache failure and choose the application contract
description: Memcached nodes do not coordinate replication or invalidation for the application. Change the routing and refill safeguards to see which failures reach the database or the user.

routingOptions.label: Modulo routing
routingOptions.detail: Compute hash(key) modulo the current server count. A pool-size change remaps most keys.

routingOptions.label: Consistent hashing
routingOptions.detail: Place nodes on a hash ring so one node loss remaps roughly that node's share.

refillOptions.label: Every miss refills
refillOptions.detail: Concurrent misses independently fetch and write the same value.

refillOptions.label: Single-flight per key
refillOptions.detail: One application request rebuilds a key while peers wait or use a fallback.

refillOptions.label: Meta-protocol lease
refillOptions.detail: The winner token coordinates recache ownership through Memcached's meta protocol.

writeGuardOptions.label: Blind cache set
writeGuardOptions.detail: Any completed refill can overwrite the cache, even if it read an older source version.

writeGuardOptions.label: CAS-guarded update
writeGuardOptions.detail: Write only when the item's compare-and-set token still matches the observed version.

writeGuardOptions.label: Versioned key
writeGuardOptions.detail: Publish a new immutable key and move readers by changing the version in the key.

scenarios.label: One cache node disappears
scenarios.detail: Clients rebuild their server list while live reads continue.

scenarios.label: A hot key expires
scenarios.detail: A popular aggregate reaches its TTL during peak traffic.

scenarios.label: An old refill finishes last
scenarios.detail: Two misses read different database versions and complete out of order.
